name: Asteroids Arcade
summary:
Prepare for an intense retro space battle in Asteroids Arcade. Pilot your ship through a dangerous asteroid field and blast away waves of angry, sentient rocks that are out to destroy you. This is a modern take on the classic arcade shooter, designed for quick, action-packed gameplay on your mobile device.

Your mission is simple: survive. Use your skills to navigate your ship, dodge incoming threats, and unleash a barrage of laser fire to break apart giant asteroids. Be careful, as larger rocks split into smaller, faster, and more unpredictable fragments. The further you progress, the more challenging the waves become.
